❤️ colourful roots visual pattern out ❤️  What to Expect in This Pattern: - The pattern is written in English. - It spans 19 pages. - You'll find plenty of helpful images throughout the pattern. Please note, I don't include images for sewing on buttons, creating the right button border, or showing how to make a slip stitch, I do provide clear images for making the buttonholes. - The pattern is written in a small/medium size. However, you’ll find bolded and underlined instructions to adjust the pattern to any size! - While the yarn colors I used are specified, the color placement is left to your creativity, making each cardigan fully customizable and unique.
